dialogues.speaker: Zhuhan
dialogues.text: Qingce Village Armwrestling Champion, huh... *sigh* Alright, you're signed up...

dialogues.speaker: Clash Competitor
dialogues.text: ...Huh? Aren't they a Vision bearer, though? Why are they trying to enter The Clash?

dialogues.speaker: Zhuhan
dialogues.text: Uh... I—I have to ask... aren't you the traveler that helped Liyue fight off that ancient god...?

dialogues.speaker: Clash Competitor
dialogues.text: The one that spoke with Lady Keqing at the Rite of Parting!

dialogues.speaker: Clash Competitor
dialogues.text: #Oh! Oh! I wonder if I can get {F#her}{M#his} autograph later?

dialogues.speaker: Zhuhan
dialogues.text: I—I trust you are aware that... only those without Visions can enter the tournament?

dialogues.speaker: Zhuhan
dialogues.text: Really? B—But from what I've heard, the things you're capable of in combat are... nothing short of extraordinary... You walk into the most dangerous situations imaginable, face off against all sorts of monsters — even the Fatui — and always come out on top!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Yup! {F#She}{M#He} still doesn't have a Vision though. See for yourself!

dialogues.speaker: Zhuhan
dialogues.text: My apologies, I didn't mean to be rude. I'm sure a great hero like yourself would have no reason to lie. Now, could I ask you to provide a few claims to fame?

dialogues.speaker: Zhuhan
dialogues.text: It's just a formality for you, of course, but I have to make a record of competitors' achievements as part of the sign-up process...

dialogues.speaker: Zhuhan
dialogues.text: So far I've got "Defeated the ancient god, Osial," so that's one. Do you... have any others?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah, and also a dragon, too! Put down "Battle with Stormterror"!

response.speaker: Clash Competitor
response.text: Whoa...

response.speaker: Clash Competitor
response.text: #Might as well declare {F#her}{M#him} the champion already.

response.speaker: Clash Competitor
response.text: I wonder if it's too late to withdraw?

response.speaker: Zhuhan
response.text: Okay, um... that's plenty... Actually, this is the most dazzling track record I've ever seen, by a long shot...

response.speaker: Zhuhan
response.text: Right, your registration is complete. Now, a brief word about the prize.

response.speaker: Zhuhan
response.text: A great hero such as yourself can surely only be here for one thing — to win the tournament and claim the grand prize, namely, a Vision.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, we're not here for that. We're here because Captain Beidou promised to take us to Inazuma if we win the tournament.

response.speaker: Clash Competitor
response.text: There's another prize too? First I've heard of it!

response.speaker: Clash Competitor
response.text: Beidou must have upped the stakes this time to attract top talent!

response.speaker: Clash Competitor
response.text: But why would anyone want to go somewhere as dangerous as Inazuma?

response.speaker: Zhuhan
response.text: ...I see, so... I take it you discussed your terms with Beidou in advance, then.

response.speaker: Zhuhan
response.text: Well, nobody expected you to sign up to a tournament like this... I can hardly believe it myself, to be honest...

response.speaker: Zhuhan
response.text: Anyway, the qualifying rounds are about to begin. I'll leave you to your preparation.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hey, so, Paimon's thinking about that whole "no Vision bearers" rule in this tournament.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Even though you don't have a Vision, most people in Teyvat think that you can't manipulate the elements without one.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So Paimon thinks you probably shouldn't use your elemental abilities during the tournament. Y'know, just to avoid any misunderstandings.

choices.text: I'm just not that interested in Visions, that's all.

response.speaker: Zhuhan
response.text: Well, I'm sure a great hero has an important reason for being here.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah, put that down! And also, "Defeated the Fatui Harbinger, Childe."

choices.text: I'm the Honorary Knight of the Knights of Favonius.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah! Also, don't forget to mention that previous battles include, but are not limited to "Stormterror" Dvalin and Fatui Harbinger, Childe.
